speaker: JEV
english: Sword, Railgun, your partner is on this channel.
korean: 검, 레일건. 동료가 이 채널에 접속했습니다.
usage: The team channel just opened after the arrival: both pilots are on comms. Say it once.

speaker: JEV
english: Both signals confirmed. Wave one is inbound.
korean: 두 신호 확인. 첫 번째 웨이브가 접근합니다.
usage: The first HUSK contacts are waking up and about to engage.

speaker: JEV
english: Four ground contacts. Which lane will each of you take?
korean: 지상 표적 넷. 각자 어느 쪽을 맡겠습니까?
usage: Three or more WICK drones just woke at once and are coming at the pilot.

speaker: JEV
english: Two airborne signals. Agree on the first target.
korean: 공중 신호 둘. 첫 표적을 함께 정하세요.
usage: Two or more PRISM snipers are awake at the same time.

speaker: JEV
english: First wave clear. Does either of you need a moment?
korean: 첫 웨이브 종료. 잠시 정비할 분 있습니까?
usage: The first fight is over and no HUSK is awake right now.

speaker: JEV
english: One wave remains. Check what your partner needs.
korean: 한 웨이브 남았습니다. 동료에게 필요한 것을 확인하세요.
usage: The nest is cleared; the field is quiet before the last threat.

speaker: JEV
english: One contact remains. Who has a visual?
korean: 표적 하나 남았습니다. 어느 쪽에서 보입니까?
usage: Exactly one enemy (or one CITADEL weak point) is left.

speaker: JEV
english: All waves clear. Both of you made it through.
korean: 모든 웨이브 종료. 두 분 모두 통과했습니다.
usage: The CITADEL is beaten and the fight is over; both pilots made it.

speaker: JEV
english: You are out of each other's sight. Call your positions.
korean: 서로의 시야 밖입니다. 각자 위치를 알려 주세요.
usage: The pilot flew far away from the partner pilot; they lost sight of each other.

speaker: JEV
english: Visual contact restored on both sides.
korean: 양쪽 모두 동료를 다시 확인했습니다.
usage: The pilot is back near the partner after being separated.

speaker: JEV
english: Laser on Railgun. Sword, your partner is moving.
korean: 레일건을 향한 레이저입니다. 검, 동료가 이동 중입니다.
usage: A PRISM is charging its lance on the pilot (Railgun).

speaker: JEV
english: Sword has the beam. Railgun has the clearer view.
korean: 검이 빔의 표적입니다. 레일건 쪽 시야가 더 좋습니다.
usage: A PRISM is charging its lance on the pilot (Sword).

speaker: JEV
english: The beam has passed. Railgun, Sword can cross now.
korean: 빔이 지나갔습니다. 레일건, 이제 검이 건널 수 있습니다.
usage: A PRISM lance just fired and is cooling down: a safe moment to move.

speaker: JEV
english: Live fuse by Sword. Railgun, keep that landing clear.
korean: 검 옆 신관이 켜졌습니다. 레일건, 착지 지점을 비워 주세요.
usage: A WICK latched on and its fuse is burning right next to the pilot (Sword).

speaker: JEV
english: A fuse separates you. Wait for the flash to pass.
korean: 두 분 사이에 신관이 켜졌습니다. 섬광이 지난 뒤 합류하세요.
usage: A WICK fuse is burning close to the pilot: back off until the flash passes.

speaker: JEV
english: Critical pulse on your partner's display. Check in.
korean: 동료 화면에 위급 맥박이 표시됩니다. 서로 상태를 확인하세요.
usage: The pilot's health is critical.

speaker: JEV
english: Sword is down. Railgun, are you able to reach them?
korean: 검이 쓰러졌습니다. 레일건, 접근 가능합니까?
usage: The pilot (Sword) just went down.

speaker: JEV
english: Railgun is down. Sword has the revive signal.
korean: 레일건이 쓰러졌습니다. 검에게 소생 신호가 표시됩니다.
usage: The pilot (Railgun) just went down.

speaker: JEV
english: Sword is back on their feet. Railgun, link confirmed.
korean: 검이 일어섰습니다. 레일건, 연결 확인했습니다.
usage: The pilot (Sword) is back up after going down.

speaker: JEV
english: Railgun is responding again. Sword, your link held.
korean: 레일건이 다시 응답합니다. 검, 소생 연결이 유지됐습니다.
usage: The pilot (Railgun) is back up after going down.

speaker: JEV
english: Both voices are back. Take a moment to regroup.
korean: 두 목소리가 돌아왔습니다. 잠시 합을 맞추세요.
usage: The pilot is back up and no enemy is close: time to regroup.

speaker: JEV
english: Both of you see the mark. You may coordinate on it.
korean: 두 분 모두 표식을 확인했습니다. 같은 표적을 맡을 수 있습니다.
usage: The pilot just locked onto a target.

speaker: JEV
english: Sword's weak-point mark is visible to Railgun.
korean: 검이 표시한 약점이 레일건에게 보입니다.
usage: The pilot (Railgun) just locked onto a glowing CITADEL weak point.

speaker: JEV
english: Shared mark expired. Who still has visual contact?
korean: 공유 표식이 만료됐습니다. 어느 쪽에서 아직 보입니까?
usage: The locked target slipped out of sight and the lock dropped.

speaker: JEV
english: Two targets in view. Railgun, which one needs a mark?
korean: 표적 둘이 보입니다. 레일건, 어느 쪽에 표시가 필요합니까?
usage: Two enemies sit under the pilot's (Railgun) sight at once.

speaker: JEV
english: Railgun lost the flyer. Sword, can you see it?
korean: 레일건이 비행체를 놓쳤습니다. 검 쪽에서는 보입니까?
usage: The pilot (Railgun) lost the lock on a PRISM sniper.

speaker: JEV
english: Visual restored. You are tracking the same flyer.
korean: 시야 복구. 두 분이 같은 비행체를 추적 중입니다.
usage: The pilot locked back onto the target it had lost.

speaker: JEV
english: Outside blade range. Railgun, do you have an angle?
korean: 검 사거리 밖입니다. 레일건, 쏠 각도가 나옵니까?
usage: The pilot (Sword) locked onto a target far beyond blade reach.

speaker: JEV
english: Railgun's view is blocked. Sword has the nearer angle.
korean: 레일건 쪽이 가려졌습니다. 검이 더 가까운 각도에 있습니다.
usage: Debris blocks the pilot's (Railgun) line of fire to the locked target.

speaker: PARTNER
english: Contact behind you! Turn around!
korean: 뒤에 적! 돌아봐!
usage: An awake HUSK is close behind the pilot.

speaker: PARTNER
english: Incoming from above!
korean: 위에서 온다!
usage: Missiles or a HUSK are coming down from above.

speaker: PARTNER
english: Big one on your radar. It's closing in!
korean: 네 레이더에 큰 놈 있어. 다가오고 있어!
usage: A big threat closes in: a PRISM sniper nearby or the CITADEL itself.

speaker: PARTNER
english: Radar's clear. We're safe for now.
korean: 레이더 깨끗해. 일단 안전해.
usage: No HUSK is awake anymore: the area is clear for now.

speaker: PARTNER
english: Hit the glowing spot. That's its weak point!
korean: 빛나는 데 쏴. 거기가 약점이야!
usage: The CITADEL (or a PRISM lens) shows glowing weak points to shoot.

speaker: PARTNER
english: Go, go, go! I've got your back.
korean: 가, 가, 가! 뒤는 내가 맡을게.
usage: Push forward together into the fight.

speaker: PARTNER
english: Hold up. Wait for my call.
korean: 잠깐. 내 신호 기다려.
usage: Wait a moment before moving on.

speaker: PARTNER
english: Stay on me. Don't drift off.
korean: 나한테 붙어. 떠내려가지 마.
usage: The pilot drifted far away from the partner.

speaker: PARTNER
english: Thanks. That was close.
korean: 고마워. 큰일 날 뻔했어.
usage: Relief after a close call or the end of the fight.

speaker: PARTNER
english: Nice shot!
korean: 나이스 샷!
usage: The pilot just destroyed an enemy or a weak point.

speaker: PARTNER
english: Okay, you're good. Health's back up.
korean: 좋아, 이제 괜찮아. 체력 돌아왔어.
usage: The pilot's health recovered after being low.
